note: Wall-pilot rules of the fast race-cue pilot inside the obstacle stack (visual_brain --obstacle-stack on|shadow; off by default and outside the stack; --wall-pilot off removes them from the stack). 'turn_first': haltere.liftoff.fast_race_cue.TurnFirstConfig, turn before translating at a wall when the next checkpoint is far off the heading (a hairpin). 'ceiling_guard': haltere.liftoff.fast_race_cue.CeilingGuardConfig, keep the looming TTC governor's terrain climb out of ceilings and overhangs. Generic and course-agnostic: they read only the pilot's own state, the causal looming samples and the visible checkpoint marker. The values are a-priori (the M2 round-2 task values: stand-off or a wall brake below about 1.5 m/s, a bearing beyond about 45-60 deg, a request of at most 0.5-1 m/s, a climb of about 1 m/s without persistent below-path evidence), set after inspecting the three Minus Two incidents they address (minus-brain08-gapon-01/02 ceiling, minus-fast6-gapon-01 hairpin side push); they are fitted to no replay, and were frozen before any replay of these rules. The runner refuses another version (fast_race_cue.WALL_PILOT_VERSION). The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256; a change needs a new version and a new freeze before any live flight, and every version flown is reported. Offline replays of these rules are open loop and are not flight evidence.

turn_first_notes.condition: near a wall: the TTC governor holds a stand-off (a wall sample capped the request at standoff_speed, 2 m/s, or less within standoff_s), or its wall brake capped the request within brake_recent_s while the horizontal speed is at most slow_speed; and the checkpoint marker is clamped at a side edge or corner (pilot state 'side'), or its filtered bearing (in view, or clamped at the bottom/top edge away from the corners) is engage_deg or more off the heading. The camera's horizontal half field of view is about 58 deg (focal_320 100 px), so 50 deg is a marker near the image edge
turn_first_notes.action: the horizontal request loses its component toward the wall (the horizontal part of the looming ray that capped the request, taken at engagement) and is bounded to creep_speed; the request's speed toward the wall is removed at the clearance brake_slew (15 m/s^2); the vertical request and the yaw rule are unchanged, so the assisted yaw keeps turning toward the checkpoint
turn_first_notes.release: aligned: the bearing of a marker in view (or bottom/top clamped) is within release_deg of the heading (the declared cone; the ordinary speed schedule and acceleration limits then resume); handoff: search, launch or a support climb owns the request; timeout: max_s after engagement, then no new episode for rearm_s, so the drone never hovers at a wall indefinitely

ceiling_guard_notes.unexplained_alarms: without the guard a sample without vertical evidence (below_fraction None: one of looming2's vertical windows has no evidence, or neither is urgent) counts as terrain while a climb is active. On minus-brain08-gapon-01 the alarms from the garage ceiling ahead of the climbing path (TTC 0.93 -> 0.43 s, below_fraction None, lower TTC none or 1.23 s) raised the climb from 0.4 to 3.5 m/s. With the guard such a sample is terrain only when the lower window explains it (lower TTC <= lower_ratio x alarm TTC), otherwise a wall
ceiling_guard_notes.weak_climb: a climb from such an explained sample (terrain seen by the lower window only) requests at most weak_climb (the task's ~1 m/s), refreshes the climb hold only at that level, and is ignored weak_climb_max_m above where the last below-path climb request (below_fraction >= terrain_fraction) was accepted; below-path climbs keep the TTC policy's vertical_up and climb_max_m
ceiling_guard_notes.overhead: during a climb (or an overhead hold) a sample with alarm TTC < overhead_ttc_s (the TTC policy's climb_on_s) whose expansion lies above the path (below_fraction <= overhead_fraction) or is unexplained is overhead evidence; overhead_confirm of them within the governor's confirm_window_s (0.25 s) cut the climb to 0 and start an overhead hold of hold_s, renewed by further evidence: no terrain climb, below-path samples brake like walls (terrain_brake 0 would otherwise let rising ground pass unbraked), and the whole vertical request (pilot and governor) is bounded to vertical_cap (level) and brought down at vertical_slew m/s^2 (the clearance brake_slew) instead of the pilot's 5 m/s^2. Level flight is unaffected: overhead evidence only counts during a climb or a hold
ceiling_guard_notes.not_used: looming2 already fits an 'up' window 0.12 W above the focus of expansion (ttc_upper, report only). It is not published by the camera process and the live logs do not carry it; while climbing, that window lies at the top of the image, where the HUD mask removes the upper 20 % (on gapon-01 at 18.5 s the lower window was urgent while below_fraction was None, so the upper window had no evidence under the ceiling). The guard therefore uses the fields the camera already publishes
